name: docmark_convert
description: Convert a supported document (PDF / Word .docx/.doc / PPT .pptx/.ppt / Excel .xlsx/.xls) or image (.jpg/.jpeg/.png/.bmp/.webp — invoices, ID cards, order screenshots, general OCR) into clean Markdown using the DocMark API. Provide either an existing local file path (POST /convert, multipart) or a reachable http(s) file URL (POST /convert/url, JSON). 1 page costs 1 point; HTTP 402 means points insufficient, 401 means invalid key. Requires DOCMARK_API_KEY.

file.description: Local file path to convert. Supported: .pdf .docx/.doc .pptx/.ppt .xlsx/.xls .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.bmp/.webp

url.description: Remote http(s) file URL to convert (mutually exclusive with file; posted as JSON to /convert/url).

out.description: Optional output file path to save the Markdown; default returns text.
